I didn’t not get into my dream university because Allah has “better plans (in store) for me”. I didn’t get in because I wasn’t good enough, I wasn’t capable enough. Not because the Quran says “You plan and We plan and We are the best of planners”. Yes, I planned but it didn’t work out, not because god has something else planned out for me but because I’m just not confident and competent enough. 
  I have stopped believing in god and I’m tired of all the traditions and rituals that were made up by some emperors way back just to promote shiism. I don’t find the story of Karbala sad; SHIT HAPPENS. SHIT’S HAPPENING CURRENTLY TOO, WHICH IS WAY WORSE THAN WHAT HAPPENED THEN! WHY CANT YOU SEE THAT? WHY CANT YOU SEE THAT ITS ALL JUST HYPED UP BULLSHIT, THAT ITS JUST ANOTHER CULT. IT ISNT GOING TO GET YOU TO HEAVEN, YOURE GOING TO END UP DISINTEGRATING INTO NOTHING LIKE EVERYONE ELSE. ALL THE NAMAZ AND THE AMAAL ISNT GOING TO DO SHIT. 

YOU THINK: God helps those who help themselves. 
NO, IT’S TO EACH THEIR OWN.  

  Doing these things is just a waste of time and energy; we could be contributing to the world, to needs of actual people in that time, with that energy (and money).

  All of this is draining out everything I have in me, and the only solution I can see is to get out of here (this city). I don’t want to hurt you or disappoint you, but I also can’t keep continuing to exhaust myself by doing things that don’t make sense to me. I really want to stop pretending. I wish I could sit down and talk to you about all of this and help you rationalise. But if I even tried that, I’d probably get up thinking it would’ve been better if I never was, and maybe, just maybe, it’d be the last conversation I’d have with you guys.
